import urllib.request
import json

# Check Ensembl REST API for gene information
def get_ensembl_gene(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/{gene_symbol}?expand=1"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
    except Exception as e:
        return str(e)

for gene in ["WBP4", "CDC42EP2"]:
    info = get_ensembl_gene(gene)
    print(f"Gene: {gene}")
    print(f"  ID: {info.get('id')}")
    start = info.get('start')
    end = info.get('end')
    print(f"  Genomic length: {end - start + 1 if start and end else 'N/A'} (start: {start}, end: {end})")
    transcripts = info.get('Transcript', [])
    print(f"  Num transcripts: {len(transcripts)}")
    for t in transcripts[:5]:
        t_id = t.get('id')
        t_len = t.get('end') - t.get('start') + 1
        biotype = t.get('biotype')
        is_canonical = t.get('is_canonical')
        trans_len = t.get('Translation', {}).get('length') if t.get('Translation') else 'N/A'
        print(f"    Transcript {t_id}: biotype={biotype}, canonical={is_canonical}, genomic_span={t_len}, translation_len={trans_len}")

        if t.get('is_canonical') == 1:

            # fetch transcript sequence / length
            url = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/id/{t.get('id')}?type=cdna"
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                seq_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
                print(f"  cDNA length: {len(seq_data.get('seq'))}")
            
            url_cds = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/id/{t.get('id')}?type=cds"
            req_cds = urllib.request.Request(url_cds, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req_cds) as resp:
                cds_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
                print(f"  CDS length: {len(cds_data.get('seq'))}")
